biotools.summary: FlexLMM is a Nextflow pipeline for performing linear mixed model analyses with appropriate permutations, addressing limitations in naive permutation approaches for GWAS when population structure is present. The pipeline allows flexibility in defining statistical models and is particularly useful for multi-parental crosses and model organism studies.
